the SiO2-Ag nanocomposite with high catalytic activity was successfully synthesized.
we successfully synthesized SiO2-Ag nanocomposites with a controllable morphology by a facile sol-gel method.

the preparation of mesoporous silica nanorods and the anchoring of Au particles on their surface,which is of significance for the application of mesoporous materials in catalysis,separation and drug delivery.
the preparation of mesoporous silica nanorods and the surface modification of the nanorods with Au nanoparticles.
a new way of preparation of SiO2 nanocrystal with mesopores and a method of anchoring Au nanoparticles on their surfaces.

the Au nanoparticles were anchored on the SiO2 surface in a dispresive way,and the SPR absorption peak of Au nanoparticles red-shifted with increase of the particle size.

the shape and size of SiO2 nanocrystals could be controlled by the concentration of the reagents,and the Au nanoparticles could be anchored to their surface by a multi-stage growth method,which would provide a promising way for preparing Au/SiO2 composites with special shape,structure and size.

the SiO2-Ag composites can be prepared with a multi-stage growth method and the Au nanoparticles can be anchored to SiO2 nanotubes with periodic mesopores in a dispersive manner.
